locator: I q.2 a.3 co., quinta via: Ea autem quae non habent cognitionem, non tendunt in finem nisi directa ab aliquo cognoscente et intelligente, sicut sagitta a sagittante
interpretation: A necessary condition: tending to an end by what lacks cognition requires some knowing and intelligent director. Nothing in the sentence makes the director one for all things or the immediate director.
